persistent_owners: Fixed disjoint consecutive physical-rank blocks of at most five keys; no ancestry-birth reset.
A_issuance_per_original_unit: At most 8H total over its actual footprint.
KEEP_voucher: At most H once per genuine B KEEP; distinct incoming cyclic A-gap units.
B_rule: Pool actual footprint, pay original double once, then target first and remaining touched blocks in increasing key order.

cyclic_construction.algorithm: Iterate clipped full-period map from full capacity vector.
cyclic_construction.integer_termination: At most mH strict descending period passes; one further evaluation can detect equality.
cyclic_construction.real_extension: Continuous monotone maps have a greatest coordinatewise descending limit.
cyclic_construction.invariance: Compatible with cyclic cuts and repeated periods; arbitrary physical interleavings/recreated ancestry allowed.
cyclic_construction.limitation: Closure and maximality do not imply that every funded-B guard holds.

integer_counterfamily.word: D2..N; descend N..1 keeping exactly x_j=N+1-2^j, j=0..p; K1..N; K(N-1)..1.
integer_counterfamily.initial_pair: Both full physical right vines; empty reaching prefix.
integer_counterfamily.closure: The final counted increasing/decreasing KEEP scans restore the exact labeled pair.
integer_counterfamily.relaxed_demand: Only original critical RR doubles at phases >=4; all other B costs free, physical operations unchanged.
integer_counterfamily.profile: M=2a+b upper-bounds future connector inputs, not total bank mass.
integer_counterfamily.drop: M_next <= M-1 when M>=1; zero remains zero.
integer_counterfamily.physical_reason: Retired middle-root output is at least the persistent coarse-spine output under the frozen priority.
integer_counterfamily.dry_packet: After 3H stages, at least 3H+1 original U RR demands have zero fresh input and carry at most 3H.

real_extension.recipe: After R weighted-loss stages reach I<1. Choose finite L dominating all stationary burns and floor(3H/(1-I))+1; p=R+4,q=4L+8.
